objective.subject: test: withdraw the unstable C-0005 regression
objective.body:
Independent review round 6 found that the promoted registration and cycle-warning regression accepts asynchronous log records published by an earlier phase: a late registration record from the first runtime can satisfy the later phases or add a second record. Phase seven of the assurance skill forbids changing a promoted candidate's assertions or observation window and forbids promoting an unstable candidate, so CONTRACT-TDD-015 is reclassified unstable and its target removed. C-0002 to C-0004 remain.

assurance: SKIPPED for this test-only withdrawal: it removes a regression added earlier in this delivery whose oracle accepted records from an earlier phase; the suite still gains three reverse-verified regressions, and no evidence present at base changes.

PIT: SKIPPED — verification/contract-tests is outside the core PIT test set.
